summary: Adds a Collect.isValid override that checks the Collect row type against the type derived from its input, with a unit test.

tests.evidence: New invariant check needs positive and negative cases; CollectTest covers ARRAY, MAP valid/invalid, but no multi-column ARRAY/MULTISET query-constructor case, which is exactly the case the reviewer found mishandled.

doc_comments.evidence: Override of isValid; inline comment explains the single-column case, later rewritten to reference #create.

change_description.evidence: PR body is only the Jira link; commit title matches Jira, which is the Calcite convention.

backward_compat.evidence: isValid is invoked by the planner, so a stricter check could reject Collect nodes built by existing code with a hand-derived row type; only a glance needed since the check accepts both derivations.

error_model.evidence: New litmus.fail messages include the offending row types; adequate.

correctness.evidence: Reviewer (zzwqqq) asked to compare against SqlTypeUtil.deriveCollectionQueryComponentType as Collect.create(..., SqlKind, ...) does; the initial single-column special case was replaced by that derivation in the final diff.

surprising_behavior.evidence: Planner may now fail assertions on previously accepted plans; low risk.

contradictions.evidence: Validation must agree with Collect.create/deriveRowType; initial version disagreed for multi-column query constructors (counted under correctness).

plan.why: Small cohesive change in one class plus its test.
